newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - BTPs to sink to 126.00 if 126.50 goes.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - BTPs to sink to 126.00 if 126.50 goes.

text.p: June BTPs futures on LIFFE will slip all the way to the 126.00 area if support around 126.50 gives way on Wednesday, analysts said.
The market was trading just above that level at 126.64 at 0732, down 40 basis points on the day. It hit a low of 126.56 before popping back up.
"It looks like we're going to challenge support from yesterday," said Charles Diebel, senior fixed income analyst at Technical Data in London, citing Tuesday's low of 126.50.
"If we take that out it looks like we can get all the way back to 126.00," he said. That was the low on Monday.
"Longer term, if we get through that area it looks like a top is confirmed which leaves the first correction target at 126.17" Diebel added.

He said that was a 38.2 percent retracement of the most recent rally from the low of 123.70 on April 1 to the high of 127.70 on April 7. A 50 percent retracement of the same move gives a secondary target of 125.70.
"To look constructive it would need to move through yesterday's intraday levels at 127.26 and that would suggest we are back up at the highs at 127.70," he added.
Other analysts here also noted resistance at 127.70.
That level represents a 50 percent retracement of this year's decline from the 131.76 high, the European bank said in a research note.
At the short-end, June Eurolira were quoted at 92.95 at 0758 GMT, down 0.08, continuing their descent from the high of 93.17 on Tuesday.
